Albert Einstein was a world-famous theoretical physicist who revolutionized our understanding of space, time, gravity, and energy.

## Quick facts

- **Born\:** March 14, 1879, in Ulm, Germany.
- **Died\:** April 18, 1955, in Princeton, New Jersey, USA.
- **Profession\:** Theoretical physicist.
- **Nobel Prize\:** Physics, 1921.
- **Most famous equation\:** \(E=mc^2\)\.

## His greatest discoveries

1. **Special relativity (1905)\:** Space and time are connected, and the speed of light is constant.
2. **General relativity (1915)\:** Gravity is explained as the curvature of spacetime.
3. **Mass-energy equivalence\:** His famous equation \(E=mc^2\) shows that mass and energy are interchangeable.
4. **Photoelectric effect\:** Explained how light can release electrons from materials, helping establish quantum physics.

[www.history.com](https://www.history.com/articles/albert-einstein?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.nobel.mpg.de](https://www.nobel.mpg.de/en/albert-einstein?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.uzh.ch](https://www.uzh.ch/en/researchinnovation/excellence/nobelprize/einstein.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Interesting facts

- He worked at a Swiss patent office before becoming famous.
- 1905 is known as his miracle year.
- He played the violin.
- He emigrated to the United States in 1933 after the Nazis came to power.
- He received the Nobel Prize for his work on the photoelectric effect, not relativity.
